name: Office Sirens Hard at Work
source:
An interactive visual novel about Jack, an office siren who just can’t stop saying “That’s what she said.”

Jack is sharp, stylish, and dangerously witty. The only problem? Every accidental innuendo at work triggers her uncontrollable urge to blurt out that phrase. It’s not personal—it’s compulsive. Help Jack survive the workday without getting fired (again) by mastering the art of perfectly timed interjections.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668450/]Steam[/url]]
